clips.title: The story
paras: Defias outlaws now occupy Yorgen Farmstead in southern Duskwood. The farm once belonged to Sven Yorgen, who fled north to a camp along the Darkened Bank.

Yorgen Farmstead lies in southern Duskwood, where Sven Yorgen once worked the land. Dangers drove Sven from his farm, and he retreated north to a makeshift camp along the Darkened Bank. Outlaws claimed the abandoned grounds, seeking a foothold beyond the reach of Stormwind's authorities.

The Defias Brotherhood now uses Yorgen Farmstead as a staging ground. Masked highwaymen and cutthroats hide among the decaying fences and weathered outbuildings, screened by dense trees. Defias assassins patrol the perimeter and ambush travelers who trespass on the seized property.
